cage.title: Keep private things private
cage.body: Don't paste passwords, ID numbers or other people's private details into Claude. If it's not yours to share, leave it out.

cage.title: Check anything that matters
cage.body: Claude can sound sure and still be wrong. For health, money, legal or safety questions, check a real source or a person you trust.

cage.title: Read before you approve
cage.body: When Claude offers to send, buy, delete or change something, it asks first. Read what it plans to do before you say yes.

cage.title: You're the maker
cage.body: Claude is a powerful tool, not the boss. You decide what's good enough, and you put your name on what you share.
